title: Builder BLD-205: Update to new layouts

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-205.

detail:
B2 Roles, pass BLD-205 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-205). Update to new layouts. Scope: components/builder/legacy. Build: Surface LIVE-1860's per-page action: preview the role version of each legacy block with a diff, apply as one undo step. Done when: Legacy page renders identically before the action and after undo. Gates: check:node-document-safety, check:stored-blocks, vitest suite (required test job), Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-203. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Update to new layouts in the builder: the outline prompt and ⌘K open a sheet that shows each convertible section beside its role version with what carries over; the owner's pick applies as one edit, and undo restores the page exactly (lib/builder/legacy.test.ts).
